dedupe_keys.name: simulated flood inundation maps of abu dhabi s coast under 174 shoreline protection scenarios delft3d and swan 0 5 m sea level rise

description: Simulated coastal flood depth maps for Abu Dhabi under different shoreline protection layouts. Contents: 174 scenarios under a 0.5 m sea level rise projection, produced with a physics-based hydrodynamic simulator (the record lists Delft3D and SWAN). The coastline is split into 17 segments and each scenario is a 17-value binary vector (1 = containment placed); each output is a 1024 by 1024 matrix of estimated peak water level in metres at 12,066 selected coastline locations, with a grid file mapping indices to coordinates and a Jupyter notebook for visualisation. Producer: New York University Abu Dhabi authors, supplementing a 2026 Scientific Reports article and an earlier Hydrology paper on sea level rise, tidal flooding and extreme wind. Coverage: the Abu Dhabi coastline. Format and access: 177 files (175 NumPy arrays, one notebook, one grid file), about 1.5 GB, on Harvard Dataverse (DOI 10.7910/DVN/M9625R, version 1.2 released January 2026); free. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: synthetic simulator output for one sea level scenario, not observed flooding. Simulation uses: training and testing flood surrogate models and comparing coastal defence layouts in climate adaptation planning. Related records: none identified.
